description: A contemporary residential exterior scene photographed at dusk or early evening, with deep blue twilight sky and lush green trees blurred softly in the background. Three substantial raw concrete gate pillars or fence columns recede into the middle distance along a perimeter fence line. The fence panels between the columns are vertical matte black steel slats, tightly spaced. The modern house behind the fence is a two-story structure with floor-to-ceiling black-framed glass curtain walls — warm amber interior light glows from within the rooms, visible through the glass behind the fence, creating a sense of life and warmth inside. Green foliage and garden plantings are visible on both sides of the fence. The concrete columns are raw, textured aggregate surface in warm gray tones, square in plan with a flat top cap surface. Each column cap houses a fixture that emits a concentrated warm amber glow, the warm light pooling downward across the concrete face and spreading across the paving below, creating a warm golden presence at ground level against the cool twilight sky. The scene is photographed from slightly below the cap level, looking horizontally at the nearest column in sharp focus with the two behind receding in diminishing sharpness. The mood is dramatic and modern — the warm glowing points contrasting with cool blue dusk and shadowed fence panels. Camera is at low to seated eye-level, telephoto lens compressing the receding columns, off-center composition with the nearest column in the right two-thirds. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
